comments.text:
Create the nih-plug VST3 plugin skeleton in crates/integral-vst/.

IMPLEMENTATION:
1. Add dependencies to Cargo.toml: nih_plug, nih_plug_vizia (with feature flags), integral-core
2. Implement the nih_plug::Plugin trait:
   - name: 'Integral'
   - vendor: 'sigma'
   - type: MIDI Effect (passes through audio, processes MIDI)
   - No audio parameters (this is a control surface, not an effect)
3. Implement process() to:
   - Receive incoming MIDI/SysEx events from the DAW
   - Forward outgoing SysEx via the NoteEvent::MidiSysEx output
4. Implement NoteEvent::MidiSysEx handling for SysEx I/O
5. Use nih_plug::nih_export_vst3!() macro
6. Verify the plugin loads in a DAW (or at least compiles as cdylib)

REFERENCE:
- nih-plug examples: https://github.com/robbert-vdh/nih-plug/tree/master/plugins
- The plugin does NOT process audio — it's a MIDI utility plugin
- SysEx handling: use NoteEvent::MidiSysEx for both input and output

TESTING: cargo build -p integral-vst --release should produce a .vst3 bundle

title: VST: add nih-plug skeleton with MIDI SysEx I/O
